summary: OA-1 Operations Actions: backend 38/38 pytest green (24 OA-1 + 6 Sprint A + 6 DCP-1 sub-tests via parametrize). Authored test_oa1_cross_portal.py (15 new cases) that proves ALL 7 portal tokens (admin/safety/hr/dispatch/pm/shop/fl) are accepted on read (GET /summary) and write (POST create) paths, plus the R2 photo upload happy path (upload -> presign 200 -> delete 204). Frontend smoke confirms /operations-actions list page renders oa-list-root, full 5-block coaching panel, summary tiles, all 4 filters, and oa-create-cta. Create flow (+New Action -> fill -> Save -> detail) completes in <1s (well under the 30s benchmark), mints OA-2026-000029, shows toast 'OA-2026-000029 Created'. Detail page exposes oa-detail-root, oa-det-oa-number, status badge, coaching panel, 5 status-transition buttons (assigned/in_progress/waiting/completed/closed -- 'open' button absent because current status IS open, which is the correct UI), assign toggle, edit toggle, photos+upload, notes+submit, history section. EN/ES toggle observed switching 'Operations Actions' -> 'Acciones Operacionales'.

minor.issue: portal_tokens key for Field Leadership is 'field_leadership', but several callers (and the OA-1 review request) document it as 'fl'. Documenting the inconsistency; the X-FL-Token HEADER is correctly accepted by every OA endpoint.

integration_issues.issue: When portal tokens are missing from localStorage (e.g. user lands on /operations-actions before logging in), list shows 'Portal authentication required' as a free-floating red text inside the list panel rather than redirecting to portal-login or showing a structured oa-list-empty card. Not blocking but visually jarring.

action_items: Optionally normalize multi-login response so portal_tokens['fl'] is also present (alias of field_leadership) to match the X-FL-Token naming used everywhere else.
critical_code_review_comments: operations_actions/api.py is clean, focused, and correctly returns status counts under data['counts'] with sibling total_open/mine_open/as_of -- matches constitution.

Photo upload enforces both content_type and magic-byte (verified via test_photo_upload_rejects_non_image: fake jpeg text body -> 422). Real PNG with valid signature succeeds end-to-end against live R2.
Frontend oa/* components use data-testid extensively -- excellent testability. CoachingPanel.jsx implements all 5 blocks with stable testids.
Cross-portal acceptance is consistent: a single _require_oa_actor dependency means there is no portal-level write asymmetry, exactly as the constitution mandates.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke checks (list testids 13/13, new form testids 10/10, detail testids 13/13)

test_credentials: Super admin: jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123! via POST /api/auth/multi-login (yields portal_tokens for admin/pm/shop/hr/safety/dispatch/field_leadership). Frontend stores tokens at localStorage keys 'masci.{portal}.token'.
seed_data_creation: Each cross-portal test creates one OA per portal (TEST_OA1_xportal_*) plus one photo-happy-path OA. UI smoke created TEST_OA1_e2e_create (OA-2026-000029). All non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OA-1 backend is rock solid (53 cases green). When you write playwright scripts, log in via /api/auth/multi-login and stash tokens at localStorage keys 'masci.admin.token', 'masci.pm.token', 'masci.hr.token', 'masci.safety.token', 'masci.dispatch.token', 'masci.shop.token', 'masci.fl.token' (the FL key in the API response is 'field_leadership' -- alias it). The detail page hides oa-action-set-status-{current_status}, so checking for all 6 status buttons simultaneously will always return 5; this is correct UX, not a bug.
rca of the issue: No defects found. The two notes (FL key naming + ungraceful 'Portal authentication required' string) are polish items, not regressions.
